entries.description: Remote freelance work from Seoul during my exchange year. After starting on bug fixes, I spent most of the mission turning Python proofs of concept for external API integrations into production code: scheduled jobs that fetch and synchronise data from those APIs, and the frontend views that display it.

Six-month internship on an internal GitLab analytics tool that helps Bouygues Telecom's IT department govern its code, with metrics such as repository size and technologies in use planned next. Full stack in Java and React, with most of my work on the Java backend.
Mentoring first-year and second-year students in C, C++, Python, algorithms and software engineering while reviewing projects and helping them solve technical challenges.
Discovered professional mobile development practices while contributing to internal development tasks and gaining experience in collaborative projects.
